# Sarah

## Overview

- **Age:** eight years old (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055), [v3 ch.Romance P13](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0013), [v3 ch.Romance P15](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0015)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Odette Ann](../character/odette-ann.md) (cousin)

## Appearance

Sarah is a diminutive individual who dresses in worn black garments. She is also a giant, smooth, gray-and-white feline who possesses a massive sense of self-respect.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055), [v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058)_

## Personality

Sarah is an eight-year-old feline who possesses a deep sense of self-respect that remains unaffected by her humble origins. She is also recognized as an extraordinary mouser.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058), [v3 ch.Relationships P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059)_

## Traits

- massive self-respect (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058)</sub>

## Abilities

- extraordinary mouser (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059)</sub>

## Goals

_Not yet known._

## History

Twenty years prior, Sarah was forced by her father to turn away a suitor she cared for deeply because he was poor. She later chose to marry [Thomas](../character/thomas-sowerby.md) rather than W. O. Seaman, using her maiden name of Crowe.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P63](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0063), [v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058), [v3 ch.Relationships P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059), [v3 ch.Romance P13](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0013)_
